integrity: The claim is supported by a complete cyclic-gap and Johnson-triangle proof and two included, reproducible, independently structured finite enumerators; independent scholarly audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result applies only to maximum independent sets of squared cycles of order at least six and the specified token-slide rule. No claim is made for smaller independent sets, full shortest-path formulas in the 4-regular case, or absolute historical priority. Independently reproduced finite cases are not substituted for the infinite proof.
title: Frozen, cyclic, and four-regular maximum-packing reconfiguration on squares of cycles
